weather_report:
As the evening settles over Boston, a gentle curtain of partial cloudiness wraps the city, with the temperature hovering in the low fifties—comfortably cool. A soft breeze from the southwest whispers promises of a serene night, inviting leisurely strolls through the quiet streets adorned with flickering lamplight. Those who venture out might dress in a light jacket or cozy sweater, anticipating the cool embrace of autumn air that beckons one to breathe deeply and relish the moment.

Tomorrow unfolds with the sun casting a cheerful glow over the cityscape, reaching a peak warmth in the mid-sixties, before gently retreating into the breezy embrace of mid-afternoon. The sky promises clarity, free of fog or haze, encouraging a canvas for leisurely pursuits. It is a day best spent in quiet reflection at a long-desired café, perhaps in the company of a good book or a stroll along the Charles River, where the sun-dappled water invites one’s thoughts to drift. With the wind dancing briskly, a light layer will serve well through the day, maintaining comfort while embodying the simple elegance of this autumnal day in Boston.
